title: Scalar extension and geometric exchange satisfy the normalized mate rectangle
statement:
Let $\Lambda\to\Lambda'$ be a morphism of commutative condensed rings [sk-def-sfb-coefficient-morphisms]. On small pro-etale sites use pulled-back coefficient rings $\Lambda_T,\Lambda'_T$, ordinary unbounded derived internal module categories and the canonical derived geometric adjunctions $u_R^*\dashv Ru_{*,R}$ [sk-def-sfb-module-derived-pushpull, def-weil-size-convention]. Put $T_T=\Lambda'_T\otimes^L_{\Lambda_T}-$ [sk-def-sfb-derived-extension-of-scalars]. Let $X'\xrightarrow{a}X$, $C\xrightarrow{c}Y$, $f:X\to Y$, $f':X'\to C$ form a chosen cartesian square [def-weil-pbc-cartesian-square]. Write $\operatorname{Ex}^R:c_R^*Rf_{*,R}\to Rf'_{*,R}a_R^*$ for the actual unit--square--counit exchange [def-weil-pbc-ambient-ringed-exchange]. Let $\lambda_u:u_{\Lambda'}^*T_{\mathrm{target}(u)}\xrightarrow{\sim}T_{\mathrm{source}(u)}u_\Lambda^*$ be the balanced K-flat scalar/pullback comparison of [lem-sfb-kflat-scalar-comparison-normalization]. Define $\rho_{u,J}:T_{\mathrm{target}(u)}Ru_{*,\Lambda}J\to Ru_{*,\Lambda'}T_{\mathrm{source}(u)}J$ to be the $u_{\Lambda'}^*\dashv Ru_{*,\Lambda'}$ adjunct of $T_{\mathrm{source}(u)}(\varepsilon_{u,\Lambda,J})\circ\lambda_{u,Ru_{*,\Lambda}J}$. For every $J$ there is an equality
$$Rf'_{*,\Lambda'}(\lambda_{a,J})\circ\operatorname{Ex}^{\Lambda'}_{T_XJ}\circ c_{\Lambda'}^*(\rho_{f,J})=\rho_{f',a_\Lambda^*J}\circ T_C(\operatorname{Ex}^\Lambda_J)\circ\lambda_{c,Rf_{*,\Lambda}J}.$$
This is an equality in $D(\operatorname{Mod}_{\Lambda'_C})$ with source $c_{\Lambda'}^*T_YRf_{*,\Lambda}J$ and target $Rf'_{*,\Lambda'}T_{X'}a_\Lambda^*J$. It uses the specified canonical internal-module adjunctions and agrees under their section-module realizations with the same normalized rectangle. No flatness, properness, constructibility, completeness or invertibility of the $\rho$ maps or exchanges is assumed.

proof.text: Choose the simultaneous normalized section scalar family and section pullback normalization for the supplied family b. This fixes the same comparisons at every endpoint.
The universally normalized internal balancing maps satisfy the scalar pullback square coherence equation before taking mates.

Apply the proved categorical mate_rectangle calculation. Transpose under the new-coefficient f′ adjunction, use mateEquiv_counit four times, and move each counit using naturality. The two transposes differ exactly by the pullback square coherence equation; injectivity of the Hom equivalence gives the internal rectangle equality.

Use the geometric realization normalization: derivedMate identifies the mate of the inverse pullback comparison with the pushforward comparison, and derivedPullComp identifies the pullback compositors. The proved iso_square_transport and mate_transport calculations show that realization carries ambient exchange to sectionRectangleExchange and rho to sectionRectangleRho. The final equation of SectionPullNormalized supplies the scalar balancing comparison. Naturality then identifies each entire internal route with its section route after the fixed source and target isomorphisms. Cancel those isomorphisms and use the internal equality to conclude the equality of section routes. No geometric mate is assumed invertible.
